description.en: Aristotle, Feynman, Lao Tzu, Turing, Munger — 18 great minds deliberate your problem
description.zh: 亚里士多德、费曼、老子、图灵、芒格——18位伟大思想家共同审议你的问题

goal.en: Get 18 great minds to deliberate your hardest problems
goal.zh: 让18位伟大思想家共同审议你最难的问题

outcome.en: Invoke a cross-examination council spanning philosophy (Aristotle, Socrates, Lao Tzu, Marcus Aurelius), design (Dieter Rams), risk (Taleb), AI (Karpathy, Ilya), systems (Meadows), and more.
outcome.zh: 召集跨领域审议团：哲学（亚里士多德、苏格拉底、老子、Marcus Aurelius）、设计（Dieter Rams）、风险（塔勒布）、AI（Karpathy、Ilya）、系统思维（Meadows）等。

reason.en: 18 persona agents: Aristotle, Socrates, Sun Tzu, Marcus Aurelius, Machiavelli, Lao Tzu, Ada Lovelace, Feynman, Linus Torvalds, Musashi, Alan Watts, Karpathy, Ilya, Kahneman, Meadows, Dieter Rams, Taleb, Munger.
reason.zh: 18个人格 Agent：亚里士多德、苏格拉底、孙子、Marcus Aurelius、马基雅维利、老子、Ada Lovelace、费曼、Linus、宫本武藏、Alan Watts、Karpathy、Ilya、卡尼曼、Meadows、Dieter Rams、塔勒布、芒格。

en: Council, deliberate the ethics of this AI decision
